from pathlib import Path
T=Path(__file__).parent
s=(T/'publish.py').read_text()
s=s.replace("'control_old':'连续标签 · 旧标签对照'", "'control_old':'连续标签 · 旧标签H20主对照'")
pos=s.index('\ndef official')
s=s[:pos]+"\ndef selected_path(name):\n    if name=='control_old':return BASE/'metrics/control-old.json'\n    treatment='old' if name in REUSED else read(BASE/'configs/single-source-amendment.json')['job_treatments'][name]\n    return (PREVIOUS if name in REUSED else BASE)/'metrics'/f'{name}-{treatment}.json'\n"+s[pos:]
first=s.index('    docs={};treatments={}');end=s.index('    complete=',first)
s=s[:first]+"    docs={}\n    for name in ['control_old',*COMPARISON]:\n        p=selected_path(name)\n        if p.exists():docs[name]=read(p)\n"+s[end:]
first=s.index("    for name in ['control',*COMPARISON]:");end=s.index("    for j in progress['jobs']:",first)
s=s[:first]+s[end:]
s=s.replace("['control_new',*COMPARISON,'control_old']", "['control_old',*COMPARISON]").replace("['control_new',*COMPARISON]", "['control_old',*COMPARISON]")
s=s.replace('用户指定 H20／patience50 配对控制。','用户指定 H20／patience50，并于本轮明确仅使用效果更好的旧标签样本。')
s=s.replace('n=3/7分档后输入完全相同，复用同一次训练；n=15/20/30/50仍余1/2/1/2条跨档。完全相同输入的复用不算独立重复训练，不能用于估计数值训练噪声。','n=7已完成的五个new命名作业因新旧分档标签逐值相同而复用；其余n只训练旧标签。新旧标签差异数仅保留输入预检记录，本轮不再做双样本配对重训。')
s=s.replace('同一缩放用于旧标签配对','沿用前轮旧标签分档的同一固定缩放')
s=s.replace('直接对照为最近H20/patience50','直接对照为旧标签H20/patience50（连续标签净年化31.31%）；前轮n5/n10也统一取旧标签结果')
# Unused paired table branch is removed so no new sensitivity claim is implied.
first=s.index("    if summary['paired_sensitivity']:");end=s.index("    if summary['early_stopping']:",first)
s=s[:first]+s[end:]
s=s.replace("str(TMP/'plot.py')", "str(TMP/'plot_single.py')")
s=s.replace("p=(PREVIOUS if name in REUSED else BASE)/'metrics'/('control-new.json' if name=='control_new' else f'{name}-new.json')", "p=selected_path(name)")
s=s.replace("name=='control_new'", "name=='control_old'")
s=s.replace("str((BASE/'metrics/quantile7-new.json').relative_to(ROOT))", "str(selected_path(REPRESENTATIVE).relative_to(ROOT))")
s=s.replace("['frozen-study.json','prepared-inputs.json','harness-plan.json','evaluation.yaml']", "['frozen-study.json','prepared-inputs.json','harness-plan.json','evaluation.yaml','single-source-amendment.json']")
s=s.replace("'paired_control_ref':plan['paired_control']", "'paired_control_ref':'training-target/horizon-style-p50-20261105-v1','primary_label_source':'old','primary_control_evaluation':str((PRIOR/'metrics/stability-20261106-old-model.json').relative_to(ROOT)),'source_amendment':read(PROGRESS)['source_amendment']")
s=s.replace('全部方案及同源连续对照见详细报告。','只用旧标签样本；全部方案及旧标签连续对照见详细报告。')
s=s.replace('所有候选、旧标签配对和局限见详细报告。','所有单样本候选和局限见详细报告。')
(T/'publish_single.py').write_text(s)
s=(T/'plot.py').read_text().replace("'control_new'", "'control_old'")
first=s.index("    paired=[n for n in names");end=s.index("    p=BASE/'reports/detail.html'",first)
s=s[:first]+s[end:]
s=s.replace(",('配对敏感性：固定其余输入，只替换旧/新标签','label-sensitivity.png')", "")
s=s.replace("H20 / patience50 | fixed five-seed ensemble | historical selection window", "Old-label H20 / patience50 | five-seed ensemble | historical selection window")
(T/'plot_single.py').write_text(s)
print('Single-source report uses old-label metrics throughout; no new paired-sensitivity table.')
